## NVENCForge 2.2.5: older graphics cards are used again

A fix for a mistake introduced in 2.2.3, found and analysed by a user. Thank you, manbug10.

- **GTX 16, GTX 10 and other older cards work on the GPU again.** These cards reject the full settings (B-frames, Temporal AQ) at the start-up check, and NVENCForge is meant to scale them down to what the card can do. Instead it stopped with "FFmpeg cannot run on this system", although FFmpeg ran fine. The error code FFmpeg returns when the card rejects a setting was mistaken for Windows refusing to start FFmpeg. NVENCForge now checks whether FFmpeg really starts before it says so, and older cards get their scaled-down settings as intended.

Update: replace `NVENCForge.exe` with the new one. Your settings stay. With NVENCForgeGUI: use the converter's update button.
